title: Core chart-square verification for one glued chart
statement: Under the local cartesian square, open immersion, over-map compatibility, and chart commutativity hypotheses, the cone formed by the chosen chart maps is a limit cone for the corresponding square [lem-pd-glued-effective-model-chart-pullback-single].

proof.text: Use the open immersion and compatibility equations to identify the local square, then apply the scheme-gluing universal property to assemble the local pullback identifications.

lean.statement: theorem glued_model_chart_pullback_core -- STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the stated hypotheses do not force the chart square to -- be cartesian; a chart may be empty while other charts cover the glued model. {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} {V : Over X} {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens) (W : I → Over Y) (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left) (W₀ : Over Y) (q₀ : V.left ⟶ W₀.left) (j : ∀ i, (W i).left ⟶ W₀.left) (i : I) (hcart : IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p) (hopen : IsOpenImmersion (j i)) (hover : j i ≫ W₀.hom = (W i).hom) (hcomm : q i ≫ j i = (U i).ι ≫ q₀) : Nonempty (IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk (q i) (U i).ι hcomm))
